tagline: 美能达胶片单反相机，1997 年发布
description: The Minolta Vectis S-100 was the lightest and smallest APS interchangeable lens auto-focus SLR camera for Minolta's V-mount lenses (and a with an adapter could mount popular Minolta Alpha/Dynax/Maxxum-mount lenses), with a splash-proof body, and Advanced Photo System film cartridges.
